function QATooltipText(tip) local text={}; for i=1,tip:NumLines() do text[#text+1]=_G[tip:GetName()..'TextLeft'..i]:GetText() or '' end; return table.concat(text,' ') end
function QAAuraIndex(id) for i=1,40 do local name,_,_,_,_,_,_,_,_,_,spell=UnitBuff('player',i); if not name then return end; if id==spell then return i end end end
GameTooltip:SetOwner(UIParent,'ANCHOR_NONE'); GameTooltip:SetPoint('CENTER',UIParent,'CENTER',0,80)
for i=1,36 do GameTooltip:AddDoubleLine('Previous item row '..i,'Right '..i) end
GameTooltip:SetSpellByID(66)
assert(not QATooltipText(GameTooltip):find('$',1,true) and QATooltipText(GameTooltip):find('Fades the caster',1,true),QATooltipText(GameTooltip))
for i=GameTooltip:NumLines()+1,36 do assert(not _G['GameTooltipTextLeft'..i]:IsShown() and not _G['GameTooltipTextRight'..i]:IsShown(),'old tooltip row survived') end
GameTooltip:SetSpellByID(845); assert(QATooltipText(GameTooltip):find('his nearest ally',1,true) and not QATooltipText(GameTooltip):find('$',1,true)); GameTooltip:Hide(); CastSpellByID(168,'player')

GameTooltip:SetOwner(UIParent,'ANCHOR_NONE'); GameTooltip:SetUnitBuff('player',40); assert(not GameTooltip:IsShown() and GameTooltip:NumLines()==0 and GameTooltip:GetSpell()==nil and GameTooltip:GetOwner()==nil and not GameTooltip:IsOwned(UIParent)); GameTooltip:SetOwner(UIParent,'ANCHOR_NONE'); GameTooltip:ClearAllPoints(); GameTooltip:SetPoint('CENTER',UIParent,'CENTER',0,80); GameTooltip:SetInventoryItem('player',16); assert(GameTooltip:GetItem(),'equipped main-hand tooltip is missing')

QAMixedTooltip=CreateFrame('GameTooltip','QAMixedTooltip',UIParent,'GameTooltipTemplate')
QAMixedTooltip:SetOwner(UIParent,'ANCHOR_NONE'); QAMixedTooltip:SetPoint('CENTER',UIParent,'CENTER',0,80)
QAMixedTooltip:AddDoubleLine('Long weapon title','Speed 2.00')
QAMixedTooltipTextLeft1:SetFont('Fonts\\FRIZQT__.TTF',24)
QAMixedTooltipTextRight1:SetFont('Fonts\\FRIZQT__.TTF',24)
QAMixedTooltip:AddLine('Short')
QAMixedTooltip:Show(); GameTooltip:Hide()
assert(QAMixedTooltipTextLeft1:GetRight()+8<=QAMixedTooltipTextRight1:GetLeft(),'double header columns overlap')
assert(QAMixedTooltipTextRight1:GetRight()<=QAMixedTooltip:GetRight()-7,'right column exceeds tooltip')
